query: query($owner:String!,$repo:String!,$cursor:String){repository(owner:$owner,name:$repo){pullRequests(states:[OPEN],first:100,after:$cursor,orderBy:{field:CREATED_AT,direction:DESC}){pageInfo{hasNextPage endCursor}nodes{number state merged isInMergeQueue timelineItems(last:1,itemTypes:[REMOVED_FROM_MERGE_QUEUE_EVENT,ADDED_TO_MERGE_QUEUE_EVENT]){nodes{__typename ... on RemovedFromMergeQueueEvent{id reason} ... on AddedToMergeQueueEvent{id}}}}}}}
